description: This Java class 'ExpectationFileWatcher' monitors JSON expectation files for changes, sets up file watchers, and triggers expectation reloads upon modifications. It is part of the mockserver project, specifically handling expectation file monitoring and reloading.

classes.name: ExpectationFileWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches expectation JSON files for changes and reloads expectations accordingly.

methods.name: ExpectationFileWatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes file watchers if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: addExpectationsFromInitializer
methods.description: Synchronously triggers expectation reload from initializer files.
